notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/848427a5462793b495cec41d7c378ed62937056b.png[/img]

Hello explorers of Gemea!

[h1]The "Fair Weather" update is now LIVE ːsteamhappyː [/h1]
"Fair Weather" is a large care and support update aimed at allowing more people to enjoy the game.
Many improvements and system based features have been added, and every nook and cranny has been optimised to make the game run great on lower spec machines, but also truly shine for those with great systems!

At the same time, we've polished a lot of things where we could improve the look and feel of the game without sacrificing performance.

[h1]Major changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Added official OpenGL support for those suffering from DirectX issues! A lot of people have eagerly been awaiting this, we're happy to say it's finally here!
[*][b]NEW[/b]: brand new occlusion system. This gives a large performance improvement for machines that struggle to draw high amounts of geometry.
[*][b]NEW[/b]: ambient occlusion system. Faster and smoother, the new system looks great at a fraction of the cost.
[*][b]NEW[/b]: new radiosity system. Our realtime radiosity is the cornerstone of our lighting technology. This new version is a lot faster and more directly supported on a larger range of hardware.

[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: optimised LOD and mesh management system.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: faster, prettier shaders. 
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: optimised general CPU and GPU usage
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: reduced issues due to world streaming. Less performance hiccups/hitching when running around the world.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: streaming + loading optimisations. You can now get into the game world very rapidly!
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: saving system. The game can now save super-fast so there's no hiccups when auto-saving.

[*][b]FIX[/b]: camera glitch that can occur on saving
[*][b]FIX[/b]: resolved a crash that can occur when hiring farm hands for your farm - boy was it fun chasing that one down!
[*][b]FIX[/b]: solved a very rare, but repeatable crash when at Arcadia
[*][b]FIX[/b]: instances of some NPCs falling out of world 
[*][b]FIX[/b]: serious physics glitch on slower computers
[*][b]FIX[/b]: out of memory issues on some low spec machines
[*][b]FIX[/b]: multiple collision issues
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Shader/Material bug on some older GPU's
[*][b]FIX[/b]: startup crashes with some older CPU's
[*][b]FIX[/b]: solved multiple areas of player getting stuck on collision
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Escape key not working for some microsoft keyboards
[*][b]FIX[/b]: scroll wheel issues on emulated mice
[*][b]FIX[/b]: crazy mouse sensitivity on track pad
[*][b]FIX[/b]: wide screen aspect ratio issue on a menu
[*][b]FIX[/b]: crash with a specific multi-gpu setup
[*][b]FIX[/b]: solved the focus issue on Windows 8 and 3 monitor setup
[*][b]FIX[/b]: serious physics glitch on slower computers
[/list]

[h1]Hot fix 1 changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Fixed a case where Maggie would freeze game
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Resolved rare save game not loading correctly when DLC item was in use
[/list]

[h1]Hot fix 2 changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]FIX[/b]: crashes/lockup due to halloween event
[*][b]FIX[/b]: issues with Scarecrow quest
[*][b]FIX[/b]: achievements now working in offline mode (finally!)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/9a09b96120772f769e47b07c1d5a28e75b020b70.png[/img]

[h1]The "Knots That Bind" update is now LIVE ːsteamhappyː [/h1]
There is a tradition in Gemea that whenever a embarking upon a long journey, the traveler would fashion two knots out of vine; one they would fasten to their home, and the other they would keep with them as they explore the world.
These Travelers Knots are said to connect two places togethor so that you are never far from home...


[b]TRAVELERS KNOT - fast travel[/b]
The Travelers Knot allows you to instantly return to any owned farmstead, but consumes the item in the process.
After you've built your first farm, the Travelers Knot recipe will become available; simply make a Travelers Knot, and use it as a tool.
You'll be presented with a choice of which farm you wish to travel to.


[b]FREE ACCESSORIES - pack 1[/b]
To celebrate the year, we're launching a free pack of accessories -- simply install the free DLC pack, find Maggie in any village, and collect your items from her!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/427d6d775025a828f9c234f434a451002caa9a79.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/0150e5b1e8ad52dda31e4ceb35ec60eb99acfc7d.png[/img]

[h1]Major changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Fast travel to farms. Craft a Travelers Knot to quickly return to any farm you own
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Free accessory pack released
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: Localisation updates for Japanese
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: Localisation updates for Korean
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: lots of minor improvements, bug fixes, and optimisations
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Minor UI bugs in inventory
[*][b]FIX[/b]: issue with halloween scarecrow and fashionable scarecrow quest getting mixed up
[/list]


[h1]Hot Fix 1....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Stopped phantom clothing item icons appearing in Bobbintoff trader. These are empty placeholder stubs that should never appear!
[*][b]FIX[/b]: fixed a rare blocker when exiting halloween event on top of Murk
[*][b]FIX[/b]: performance issue during some dialogue with Maggie
[/list]

[h1]The Halloween Festival update is now LIVE ːsteamhappyː [/h1]
It's said that ghosts and ghouls from all over Gemea party for eternity on the other side of the night.
Every Fall, the town of Bobbintoff hosts a Halloween festival to honour this folklore, but maybe there's more to it than just a tale?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/56144146cfc809454d06d7ac8a002cee05bbea66.png[/img]
[b]TRICK OR TREAT![/b]
Get dressed up for the occasion, go trick-or-treating, and hunt down as much candy as you can!
And if you visit Trader Jack while you're there, you'll also be able to get your hands on some great new halloween items... 

[b]New languages[/b]
We now officially support [b]Russian, Japanese, and Korean[/b]. 
This is the first major release for all three, so let us know if you spot any issues!
[i]Русский язык теперь официально поддерживается![/i]
[i]日本語が公式にサポートされました！[/i]
[i]한국어가 이제 공식적으로 지원됩니다![/i]

[h1]Major changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Russian localisation (version 1)
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Japanese localisation (version 1)
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Korean localisation (version 1)
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Bobbintoff hosts Halloween every Fall
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Lots of new Halloween items
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: lots of minor playability improvements, bug fixes, and optimisations
[/list]

[h1]Minor Fix Update 1[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: fix issues with cats no being collectable or showing up when they shouldn't
[*][b]NEW[/b]: fix farm inventory scrolling on mouse
[*][b]NEW[/b]: fix fishing competition not ending if player previously cancelled 
[*][b]NEW[/b]: swap accept/cancel on controllers when system language set 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/0e32e92750e43439c4de5e9c5c04defd15cd6b11.png[/img]

[h1]The Great Peace update is now LIVE ːsteamhappyː [/h1]

As you journey to restore peace to Gemea, a new creature has appeared.

This creature was last seen so long ago that is now believed to be a myth.  A creature that only exists in stories.

The people say it's a good omen - they are said to only appear in lands where wise and benevolent people reside in peace...

This, however, is not the only creature spotted in Gemea. Kari and Tack are rushing around the island trying to collect as much information as possible about the new fox species that have been spotted!

[i]p.s. We now officially support Simplified Chinese! 我们现在正式支持简体中文！ [/i]

[h1]Major changes....[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Simplified Chinese Localisation
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Sightings of different sub-species of Grass Fox have been made all over Gemea...
[*][b]NEW[/b]: Legend tells of a mythical animal that may appear for those that bring about the Great Peace.

[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: dismiss a farm hand from the farm management book.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: player can cancel a quest board task by interacting with the quest board again.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: added custom waypoints to the map! You can cycle through these to change the icon type.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: custom pathing is now possible -- you can now set a custom destination for your Celestial Compass.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: it's now possible to toggle active quests on and off from the map
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: mouse interaction with the map is now improved:
    1) Navigation is now edge-scrolling based instead of click+dragging.
    2) The mouse pointer is now the selection reticule instead of it locked to the center of screen.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: updated controller support -- more controllers should now work natively.
[*][b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]: Cats no longer instantly disappear if their appearance rules are invalidated but you're actively looking for them.

[*][b]FIX[/b]: NPC world icons sometimes did not disappear after the NPC had moved on from the area.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: made 2 tree plots in the Desert region easier to access -- they were previously VERY hard to get to.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: when backpack is full, don't allow auto-pickup of loot drops -- just notify of full backpack.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: NPC grunt variations implemented -- these were previously limited to a small set of available 'voice types'
[*][b]FIX[/b]: animal previews are back
[*][b]FIX[/b]: adopt a groffle quest, befriend not completable if player builds pen and adopts groffle before getting quest
[*][b]FIX[/b]: fabbit bounce sounds are now working
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Great beard off quest, resolved some players having issue with finishing quest
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Spike the sprite no longer appears in Arcadia after collection and loading.
[/list]

edit: we've made some further fixes and released as a minor update:
[h1]Minor Updates...[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] resolved missing language data issue for new Russian, Japanese or Korean region players. These languages are in the works but aren't yet included. Stay tuned!
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] fixed missing mouse input in farm edit mode.
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] added a small graphical fix to the gamma code. This was showing bad values in low light conditions for a small number of graphics cards.
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] fixed cat interaction issue (When they were still visible, but its appearance condition meant it wanted to hide, it wasn't able to be collected. You can now collect them whenever they're visible)
[*] [b]Fix:[/b] fix biome happiness counts for trees and cats -- these numbers were wrong, so it looked like some trees/cats were missing for some people when in fact they had them!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/d5fbf9e9fdb543fa7a68e07ba13aa905a54ce65a.png[/img]

[h1]The Quality of Life update is now LIVE :O[/h1]

Life just got a little bit nicer in Gemea...
This update addresses some remaining game flow issues, expands player inventories, fixes a number of bugs, and paves the way for more juicy content updates in the near future.

[i]p.s. That sort button is mighty handy...[/i]

[h1]Major changes....[/h1]
[list]
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: increased default backpack size by 1.6x -- it now fits 90 stacks of items
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: increased storage chest size by 2x -- it's now a whopping 800 stacks
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: added a gamma slider in the visual menu.
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: added an auto-sort button for backpack and storage chest inventories.
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: added detection of minimum required hardware and an error box to the start of the game. This is nicer than a random crash or obscure bugs, and gives some helpful information.
    [*] IMPROVEMENT: logged system information to help with future debugging of issues.
    [*] BALANCE: A number of smaller balancing tweaks to level out some tasks.
    [*] FIX: fixed quest board NPC info not being regenerated correctly after loading.
    [*] FIX: game darkens after using compass (plus some other rarer conditions).
    [*] FIX: fixed known areas in the world with bad ground collision.
    [*] FIX: resolved blocker bug behind Interlade chest.
    [*] FIX: Woodrow now disappears properly after collecting him. Cheeky little sprite!
    [*] FIX: a few materials were not working with the global illumination rendering system.
    [*] FIX: fishing collection trophy now checks when you trade for fish.
    [*] FIX: fixed collision atop of cave near grasslands farm. Hid a new chest there too for the trouble ;)
    [*] FIX: checking for necessary backpack space to fit reward items in Kozi quest line and Find the Crew quest.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348787/e905bc5379c1700fe53cab86a73aea2fb39a76ed.png[/img]

Hi all,
We've just gone live with update #3. This patch resolves some remaining issues, and also improves certain balance points to improve the game flow!

[h1]Major changes:[/h1]
- BALANCE: mortar, glue, and nail trade balance - These have been increased in base quantity and some extras peppered throughout different traders.
- BALANCE: new secondary base tier recipes - water, rivets, nails, glue, mortar, habedashery; These have been added to their respective guild lists.
- BALANCE: starter farm now gifts you with a Gardening Plot and a Tree Plot to help accelerate farming in the game.
- BALANCE: economy events nerfed to address the ease of trading vs crafting.
- BALANCE: Heartwood trade a little rarer to prevent insta-completion of quest.
- BALANCE/FIX: Added surplus cats to the world! You'll now be able to find more cats than necessary to finish the quest, and have some to spare :)
- FIX: Prevent farms from getting odd placement/overlapping items and resources (will also attempt to fix farms already in this state)
- FIX: Adopted critters return to their pens if they wander too far away, or are visually missing.
- FIX: Mian sprite not disappearing after collection
- FIX: Updated German string for controllers menu item
- FIX: Updated Kari's hint about what Fluffcubs eat.
- FIX: some npc's falling through the ground or getting embedded in the ground(!)
- FIX: blocker in Hearthwind Vale near farm
- FIX: Fish collection trophy triggers only after you catch another fish
- FIX: Crash - when hitting exit button twice on player storage chests
- FIX: Player got stuck when when placing two plant boxes side by side
- FIX: Trading out old kingdom coins, they're still spent when bag is full and trade wasn't possible
- FIX: can lose hat if inventory full and unequipping
- FIX: cleaned up the back of the observatory -- was NEARLY blocking collision
- FIX: filter on farm chest isn't working
- FIX: visuals menu requests restart without changing settings
- FIX: Cleaned up some collision in Radiant Sands
- FIX: changed how the Great Beard-Off quest triggers to avoid issue where player couldn't progress

- FIX: Updated German string for controllers menu item
- FIX: Updated Kari's hint about what Fluffcubs eat.
- FIX: some npc's falling through the ground or getting embedded in the ground(!)
- FIX: blocker in Hearthwind Vale near farm

- FIX: Crash - when hitting exit button twice on player storage chests
- FIX: Player got stuck when when placing two plant boxes side by side
- FIX: Trading out old kingdom coins, they're still spent when bag is full and trade wasn't possible
- FIX: can lose hat if inventory full and unequipping
- FIX: cleaned up the back of the observatory -- was NEARLY blocking collision

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
We've had a *lot* of people exploring Gemea, and inevitably we've found our share of bugs! So without further ado, here's Update 1

[h1]Major changes:[/h1]
- added cloud saves
- integrated xinput; this should help a lot of controllers that weren't previously working. We expect there's still going to be some that aren't playing nicely though, and we'll need to create custom profiles for those.
- Fix for black box (mouse cursor) in the center of the screen.
- Cleaned up shader compatability -- this will likely affect anyone having visual/rendering issues.
- Fixed all known collision blockers
- Increased web interaction radius; solves hard-to-remove webs!
- Fixed duplicating farm object issue
